name: Mumbai Coastline
summary: Dense coastal megacity vulnerable to regional sea level rise, astronomical king-tide flooding, and Mithi river mouth storm surges.

hotspots.title: Suburban Rail & Marine Drive Transit
hotspots.description: Daily transit corridor carrying 3.5 million commuters along the western coastal edge.
hotspots.impactCarryOn: Water here submerges train tracks and halts commuter rail lines during routine high-tide surges.
hotspots.impactProtect: Tiered seawall revetments block wave splash and automated pumps clear rail ballast in 15 minutes.

hotspots.title: Mahim Causeway Commercial Market
hotspots.description: Dense retail street with over 400 ground-floor shops, pharmacies, and small businesses.
hotspots.impactCarryOn: Water here reaches this shopfront's door during spring tides, ruining stock and forcing shop closures.
hotspots.impactProtect: Tidal backflow gates and raised pedestrian curbs keep street water away from shopfront thresholds.

hotspots.title: Mithi River Estuary Ground-Floor Homes
hotspots.description: Vulnerable ground-floor residential homes bordering the tidal Mithi river mouth.
hotspots.impactCarryOn: Water here enters ground-floor living rooms up to window sills, forcing families to flee upstairs.
hotspots.impactProtect: Restored mangrove wetlands slow tidal surges and elevated home plinths keep living rooms dry.

stats.label: Sea Level Rise (AR6)
stats.context: Regional relative mean sea level rise above 2020 baseline at Mumbai tide gauge.

stats.label: High-Tide Flood Days
stats.context: Days where astronomical high tides breach coastal stormwater drains in low-lying transit corridors.

stats.label: Annual Commercial Losses
stats.context: Direct physical inventory and operational damage to ground-floor retail shops along coastal roads.

stats.label: Ground-Floor Homes at Risk
stats.context: Ground-floor residences in Mithi basin and Mahim facing recurrent seasonal tidal water intrusion.

carryOn.description: Regional sea levels rise by up to 88 cm by 2100 (and 165 cm by 2150), turning monthly high tides into citywide transit shutdowns and chronic ground-floor flooding.
keyPoints: High-tide flood frequency escalates tenfold by 2075
Routine saltwater inundation paralyzes Western and Harbour commuter train corridors
Ground-floor commercial shops face over ₹2,400 Crore in recurring inventory losses

protect.description: Paris Agreement stabilization paired with 2,400 hectares of mangrove restoration, tidal gates, and raised permeable infrastructure limits mean sea level rise to 36 cm.
keyPoints: Restored mangrove sponges absorb 60% of cyclonic wave energy along Mithi mouth
Automated high-capacity flood pumps safeguard critical commuter rail lines
Community-level raised thresholds protect over 100,000 ground-floor homes
